title: The Northern Lights
text: The lights in the sky come down to the ice in green and violet ribbons and dance among you. They are colder than the snow. They brush your faces like curious fingers, as if trying to learn what you are.

options.label: Dance with the lights, and let them learn what you are.

outcomes.text: There is cold joy in it, and laughter you did not know you had left.
The lights leave frost where they touched, and it does not melt.

options.label: Stand still and let them look, hoping curiosity is all they feel.

outcomes.text: They pass through you, and something in you is lighter when they go.
